description: This file is a shell script for managing hotspot and hostapd (access point daemon) services on a network device. It includes functions to restart hostapd, check hotspot enable status via a device management interface, and configure network interfaces accordingly. The script also performs status checks and outputs relevant status messages.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service by killing existing processes and starting hostapd with a specific configuration.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills the hostapd process and restarts it with the specified configuration.
